# Hero of Bitcoin

> A Game Boy-compatible adventure set in El Salvador, with 21 bitcoin hidden throughout the game.

## Digital game

- [Hero of Bitcoin Digital](https://heroofbitcoin.xyz/digital/): Instant download paid with Bitcoin or Lightning.
- [Digital release trailer](https://youtu.be/IBqAaWS--Bg): Official trailer for the digital version on YouTube.
- [Playable demo](https://demo.heroofbitcoin.xyz): Try the game before buying.

## Product facts

- The digital game runs on Windows (x86-64), macOS (Apple Silicon) and Linux (x86-64). An English PDF quick-start guide is included.
- The included launcher selects the game language, configures a controller and starts the included game offline.
- All six listed products include the digital game with its launcher, regardless of how access is supplied. Buyers with a claim code can redeem it on /digital/ in the discount or claim code field.
- The digital game can be played in English, Dutch and Finnish. Physical game editions are in English. The landing page supports English, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, German, Korean, French, Dutch, and Finnish.
- The product page shows a live BTC amount first, with smaller USD and EUR reference prices.
- Checkout calculates the authoritative price and locks the BTC amount when it opens.
- No account or email address is required for the digital order.
